items.title: Submit itemized bill and proof of payment for ER claim
items.quote: Your claim documents must be received by September 30, 2026.
items.computation: The letter (dated September 8, 2026) states a fixed calendar date by which the requested itemized bill and proof of payment must be received: September 30, 2026. This is a private US company (not a German authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the date is simply the printed deadline. September 30, 2026 is a Wednesday, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed even if such rules were applied.

warnings: The sender is a private US company handling a health-insurance claim for an emergency room visit; if the claim documents are not received by the stated deadline the claim will simply be closed rather than referred elsewhere, so no unusual payment demand or pressure was found, but the person should verify the claims email address (claims@eshp.example) is the one on their actual policy documents before sending sensitive medical or payment records.
